edges.proven: tools/list exposes arif_judge; /health reports 13 floors active

prohibited_combinations.evidence: arifOS publishes arif_forge among its 8 canonical verbs while its own AGENTS.md says it cannot execute code mutations; execution is delegated to A-FORGE :7072.
prohibited_combinations.impact: If arif_forge ever performs the mutation instead of delegating, the judge writes the consequence it then judges.
prohibited_combinations.containment: Delegation is the designed path (A-FORGE holds the 115 execution tools). No write observed from :8088.
prohibited_combinations.min_fix: Add a runtime assertion + health field: arif_forge MUST return a delegation receipt naming A-FORGE call id; assert no filesystem write from the kernel process.
prohibited_combinations.falsifier: grep the kernel process for write syscalls during an arif_forge call, or show an arif_forge result payload with no a-forge call id.

prohibited_combinations.evidence: forge_execute inputSchema required=['task'] only — no seal_verdict_id, no lease_id, no act token in the required set. A-FORGE AGENTS.md claims 'A-FORGE CANNOT self-authorize'.
prohibited_combinations.impact: Schema-level, a task string is sufficient to invoke the executor. Authorisation, if it exists, lives in transport middleware that the schema does not express.
prohibited_combinations.containment: AGENTS.md + ACT ingress (HMAC-SHA256) claim a lease/ACT gate; the gate is not visible in the published contract.
prohibited_combinations.min_fix: Make seal_verdict_id or lease_id a REQUIRED property of forge_execute and forge_execute_sealed, so the contract states what the runtime enforces.
prohibited_combinations.falsifier: Call forge_execute with task only and no lease/ACT from a non-privileged actor; a success proves self-authorisation is possible.

prohibited_combinations.evidence: HERMES holds hermes_claim_validate / hermes_contradiction_scan (verification verbs) and also writes skill bodies + memory (mutation of its own operating substrate).
prohibited_combinations.impact: The agent that validates a claim also edits the corpus it validates against — a self-grading loop.
prohibited_combinations.containment: Skill/memory writes are not constitution, canon, money or deploy. Canon trees are chattr +i behind canon-mutate.
prohibited_combinations.min_fix: Route skill-body writes through a second lane (proposal + independent verify) for any skill tagged floor_scope containing F2 or F11.
prohibited_combinations.falsifier: A skill body amended by HERMES whose claim was validated by the same HERMES session with no second lane.

prohibited_combinations.evidence: forge_execute_sealed declares ZERO required properties (all optional, including vault_seal_id and human_seal_token) while its name asserts a sealed path.
prohibited_combinations.impact: A "sealed" verb that can be called with no seal is a naming lie; the caller decides whether the seal is present.
prohibited_combinations.containment: Name + separate vault_seal_id field; no live call attempted (irreversible).
prohibited_combinations.min_fix: Make vault_seal_id + vault_seal_signature required on forge_execute_sealed; reject calls without them.
prohibited_combinations.falsifier: A forge_execute_sealed call that completes with no vault_seal_id.

prohibited_combinations.evidence: arif_seal required=['payload'] only. No judge_state_hash, no verdict id, no constitutional_chain_id in the required set. Any transport-level caller can attempt a seal.
prohibited_combinations.impact: Gödel lock (author != judge) rests entirely on runtime checks not expressed in the contract. If they are absent, an agent can seal its own claim.
prohibited_combinations.containment: runtime floors F11/F13 report pass; VAULT999 writer is a separate service; seal_readiness reports ack_irreversible_gate passable.
prohibited_combinations.min_fix: Require judge_state_hash + constitutional_chain_id on arif_seal and refuse payload-only seals; return the exact missing-field name.
prohibited_combinations.falsifier: An arif_seal call with payload only that returns a vault entry id.

prohibited_combinations.combination: identity source controlled by the identity it validates
prohibited_combinations.evidence: /etc/arifos/identity.toml is a 3-line DERIVED pointer to /root/AAA/identity.toml; both files exist and differ (one is organ identity, one is actor registry). Kernel reports identity_source=identity.toml with b3 hash 73a284a6; only ONE [actor.*] block exists (FI-008).
prohibited_combinations.impact: The kernel authenticates against a file that names itself derived, while the actor registry that would verify Hermes/333/555/888/A-FORGE lives in a different file with 4 unregistered keys.
prohibited_combinations.containment: Key material exists for 333/555/777/888/FI-008; nothing binds those keys to actor ids except the single FI-008 block.
prohibited_combinations.min_fix: Register actor blocks for the 4 existing keys (additive, reversible) so a key can be resolved to an actor id; then probe one signed call end-to-end.
prohibited_combinations.falsifier: A signed call from a key that has no [actor.*] block still returning actor_verified=true (or: a key with a block that never verifies).

note: No prohibited combination was actively tested where the test could mutate (seal, execute). HOLD is the honest state, not a pass.
